profile.reading: This is Tietokettu, a small Finnish web hosting and IT services provider based at Piiponraitti 1 in Lempaala, Finland, a town near Tampere, operating under the corporate entity HD-decor Oy per a hosting industry directory listing. The company offers web hosting and server services, website design and implementation, information network development, ongoing maintenance, and general IT consulting for both business and consumer customers. A hosting directory profile lists the company as founded in 2019, and the companys own marketing separately claims more than five years of experience in server, hosting, and web development work, a self reported figure this registry treats as approximate promotional language rather than an independently verified founding date. This registry could not independently corroborate the 2019 founding date or the HD-decor Oy corporate linkage from a second source beyond the single hosting directory profile found this session, an honest single source limitation worth noting given the companys small scale. Lempaala is a municipality directly south of Tampere in the Pirkanmaa region of Finland, part of the greater Tampere metropolitan area, a location that places Tietokettu within reach of Finlands second largest urban and technology hub while operating as a small, locally scaled provider rather than a large national or Nordic hosting company such as Hetzner or Elisa, both of which operate much larger facilities tracked elsewhere in this registry. Finlands hosting and web services market includes a wide range of scales, from large Nordic and international operators down to municipality level providers like Tietokettu that focus on personalized service and local business relationships, a segment that has persisted in Finland alongside larger consolidated hosting brands.
